name: Same Tune
source:
A visual novel about a person wanting to prove he is better than his enemy in the orchestra. He already has a plan, now make it happen.

[From [url=https://jacqueline-koch.itch.io/same-tune]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，讲述主角渴望证明自己比管弦乐团里的死对头更加优秀的故事。他早已筹划妥当，现在就看你如何将其付诸行动了。

[摘自[url=https://jacqueline-koch.itch.io/same-tune]itch.io[/url]]
